scope.summary: ULIQ Presale V2, shared token and legacy locking source audit. NO-GO: medium operational expired-READY deadlock reproduced; no unprivileged theft/privilege-gain finding confirmed.
scope.runtimeStatus: Local tests and read-only deployed ULIQ token checks only; no Mainnet presale, vesting or locker deployment/activation verified.
scope.validationMode: Offline source audit with independent baseline/architecture and parent local deterministic and fork validation
limitations: Scope is ULIQ within packages/contracts, not the whole contract package.
All nine selected production/legacy-locker source/interface files were reviewed; legacy presale and non-ULIQ source excluded.
R-01 remains a confirmed medium operational release blocker outside the adversarial-finding classification. Zero security findings is not a clean release decision.
No selected Mainnet locker or Team/manual vesting source; future implementation and live graph coverage unavailable.
No Slither or external audit; fork uses mock USDC and bypasses Safe signatures.

threatModel.summary: ULIQ's scoped architecture consists of a shared fixed-supply ERC-20, a candidate two-round presale graph with one shared listing controller and separate round, vesting, and USDC custody instances, plus a separately classified legacy-testnet utility locker. Buyers approve USDC to their round's custody, create pending purchases through the round, withdraw before their deadline, or have anyone finalize afterward. Finalization transfers the entire allocation to vesting and USDC to the active custody treasury; beneficiaries claim against the shared listing timestamp. Wallet-held ULIQ can separately be locked and returned to the lock owner after expiry. Sources: packages/contracts/src/uliq/shared/ULIQToken.sol:12-23; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:336-424; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:99-139; packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:52-94. The repository records Arbitrum One token address 0xF2Fa252134c84Fcf260c73665BAf3f8cCBe03EEd and source-verification evidence dated 2026-09-05, while the V2 graph remains a review candidate and the available ULIQ deployment scripts target only local chain 31337 and Arbitrum Sepolia 421614. Sources: docs/archive/tasks/2026-09-05-uliq-arbiscan-source-verification.md:5-18; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:94-115; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/DeployULIQTestnet.s.sol:59-90.
assets: The one-billion-ULIQ initial supply and holders' balances and approvals. The token mints once to the constructor's allocation controller and exposes ERC20, ERC20Burnable and ERC20Permit through inheritance, with no token-specific owner or mint function. packages/contracts/src/uliq/shared/ULIQToken.sol:12-23.

Round inventory and pending/finalized purchase accounting. Each round has immutable token, custody, vesting, listing, predecessor, inventory source, pricing, caps and withdrawal-period inputs. Exact inventory funding is restricted to the immutable source and measured by balance delta. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:51-64; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:159-220.

Custodied USDC and purchase-specific refund/release entitlements. A custody instance stores buyer, amount and terminal payment state under its local purchase ID and must be separate per round. USDC donations remain surplus; the configured payment token cannot be recovered by the owner. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:35-42; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:96-132; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:159-194; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:55-60.

Beneficiary-specific finalized allocations, released totals and time-based claim rights. The vesting token, listing controller and release schedule are immutable, with allocation authority permanently assigned to one presale. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:21-25; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:75-107; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:121-139.

Legacy locker principal, position ownership, expiry and withdrawn state. The immutable token has no admin withdrawal path in this contract; unlock transfers only to the recorded owner/caller after expiry. packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:14-30; packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:47-94.

Administrative authority to bind graph components, configure lifecycle transitions and schedule listing; inventory-source authority; custody treasury recipient authority; deployment signer credentials. Candidate Arbitrum One Admin Safe is 0xf6EB22eC94be977A668967f44F89eB1e056FF70f, and confirmed initial mint recipient/candidate inventory source is Treasury Safe 0x9C96F9AE59e30786fD325EFD969884FC1f751739. The production USDC custody treasury is unresolved. These are repository-recorded planning/snapshot facts, not freshly verified runtime facts. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_MAINNET_ROLES.md:27-39; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_MAINNET_ROLES.md:45-55.

Deployment reproducibility and chain/address identity. Foundry selects Solidity 0.8.30, optimizer 200, viaIR and Paris, with an OpenZeppelin remapping; package dependency is exact OpenZeppelin 5.4.0. The existing testnet CLI passes ULIQ_TESTNET_DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY by reference to Forge, with RPC and constructor/configuration values supplied from environment variables. No credential values were read or reproduced. packages/contracts/foundry.toml:1-12; packages/contracts/package.json:19-25.
trustBoundaries: Buyer wallet -> presale round -> USDC custody: buy binds buyer to msg.sender, enforces active/window/minimum/cumulative-wallet/cap/inventory/slippage conditions, updates pending state, then asks the immutable custody to collect. Custody accepts collection only from its bound presale, rejects duplicate IDs, pulls from that buyer and requires the exact balance delta. The actual approval spender is custody, demonstrated by inspected setup callers. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:313-379; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:69-71; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:96-110; packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.t.sol:72-74.

Buyer or public finalizer -> purchase settlement: only the immutable buyer can withdraw a pending purchase at or before its deadline; any caller can finalize strictly afterward while listing is unscheduled. The beneficiary and amounts come from stored purchase data, not caller-supplied recipients. Finalization atomically transfers ULIQ to vesting, records the beneficiary allocation, and releases USDC from custody to its current treasury. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:382-424; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:113-131; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:186-194.

Inventory-source wallet -> round inventory: only immutable inventorySource may call fundInventory, once in DRAFT, following approval; exact allocationCap balance delta is required. Owner readiness additionally requires funded inventory and vesting.presale equal to the round. Returning unsold inventory is owner-controlled but accepts no recipient or amount, requires an ended state and no pending purchases, and transfers allocationCap minus totalSold to that same immutable source. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:209-232; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:293-310.

Deployment/configuration operator -> non-upgradeable contract graph: the round constructor verifies token decimals, custody paymentToken, and vesting token/listing correspondence. Custody's one-time binding verifies reciprocal usdc/paymentCustody correspondence. Vesting's one-time binding checks nonzero deployed code and no scheduled listing, but not reciprocal round identity. Listing's one-time binding checks distinct nonzero deployed contracts, but not reciprocal listing/token/predecessor/round-ID identity. Each control therefore has a distinct enforcement scope. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:159-194; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:84-94; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:75-81; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQGlobalListing.sol:31-41.

Owner -> sale/listing progression: owner-only draft window changes use a version compare-and-set and freeze once DRAFT ends. Owner activates, pauses, resumes and marks listing-pending. Round 2's predecessor restriction applies to its supplied predecessor at activation. Public callers can end an elapsed round or an economically exhausted round without pending purchases. Listing owner schedules one future timestamp only after its two configured rounds report listing-ready. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:196-206; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:235-277; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQGlobalListing.sol:44-55.

Listing controller -> vesting beneficiary: claim reads the immutable listing controller; no timestamp or a future timestamp produces zero vested amount. At listing, the immutable initial-unlock fraction is available; the remainder accrues linearly after the immutable cliff. Only the beneficiary can claim their own allocation, with accounting updated before token transfer. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:99-107; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:121-139.

Custody owner and proposed treasury -> active USDC release destination: the owner proposes/cancels a nonzero, changed treasury, while only that proposed recipient can accept. Subsequent finalized purchases release to the accepted treasury. Foreign-token recovery also goes there, but configured USDC recovery is forbidden. Custody disables ownership renunciation. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:121-169.

Owner -> ownership successor: inherited OpenZeppelin Ownable2Step requires the pending recipient to accept a transfer. Its Ownable base separately exposes owner-only renunciation. The scoped round, listing and vesting contracts inherit that behavior; the custody explicitly overrides renunciation to revert. Dependency source is locally installed supporting code. packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol:43-65; packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol:48-77; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:168-169.

Locker user -> shared token pool: lock records caller ownership and one supported initial duration, then pulls tokens; unlock checks ownership, expiry and single withdrawal, updates balances first, and sends to the caller. Only the owner can extend an existing, unwithdrawn position and expiry can only increase; extensions are not restricted to the three initial durations. packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:14-16; packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:52-94.

Backend configuration -> intended contract/network context: public-presale configuration separately consumes ULIQ_PUBLIC_PRESALE_* addresses, permits 42161 or 421614, requires distinct configured HTTP(S) RPC URLs, distinct graph contract addresses, terms when purchases are enabled, and Mainnet/Legal flags for Mainnet purchases. Legacy configuration independently requires chain 421614 and explicit testnet opt-in under NODE_ENV=production. These are backend configuration controls; they are not conditions in direct onchain buy calls. apps/api/src/uliq/publicPresale.config.ts:1; apps/api/src/uliq/publicPresale.config.ts:108-165; apps/api/src/uliq/config.ts:90-145; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:336-379.

Privileged release operator -> deployed testnet components: npm ULIQ deploy/configure commands supply environment-driven addresses, RPC and a referenced deployment key to Forge with chain 421614. The scripts independently reject chains other than 31337/421614. Full-suite deployment creates a new shared token, legacy sale/vesting/custody and locker; configuration is a separate owner-signing stage. Locker-only deployment accepts an existing code-bearing token. packages/contracts/package.json:19-22; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/DeployULIQTestnet.s.sol:59-90; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/ConfigureULIQTestnet.s.sol:29-57; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/DeployULIQLockerTestnet.s.sol:19-32.
attackerCapabilities: An unprivileged wallet can call public contract functions directly, obtain or transfer tokens, choose its approved amounts, submit purchases, choose transaction timing/order, create multiple wallet identities, donate tokens, invoke eligible permissionless finalizations and public time-based lifecycle transitions. It does not initially control owner, inventory source, immutable dependencies or another buyer's wallet. Relevant boundaries: packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:260-310; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:313-424.

An ordinary buyer can only withdraw its stored pending purchase and claim its own allocation; a lock holder can only extend or unlock its own position. A boundary failure granting someone else's payment, token allocation or principal would be a meaningful capability gain. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:382-399; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:99-107; packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:69-94.

A finalizer needs only gas-funded transaction authority to call expired-purchase finalization and receives no allocation or refund entitlement. Compromise of that ordinary caller is not equivalent to owner or treasury compromise. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:402-423.

A malicious token, custody, vesting, listing or predecessor is relevant only if privileged deployment/wiring selects it, or an external dependency subsequently changes behavior. Arbitrary external callers cannot replace the round's immutable references. Decimal/interface compatibility checks alone do not establish bytecode identity. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:51-64; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:159-194.

Compromised administrative or deployment authority is a separate, privileged scenario. Candidate Treasury and Admin Safes were recorded with the same two owners and 2-of-2 thresholds, so separate Safe addresses do not establish independent signer-compromise domains. This is dated repository evidence, not a current compromise assumption. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_MAINNET_ROLES.md:27-39.
securityObjectives: Keep pending token allocations fully backed and prevent raised USDC, sold ULIQ and cumulative per-wallet amounts from exceeding configured caps. Funding must originate from the immutable source with the exact allocation received. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:209-232; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:313-376.

Maintain mutually exclusive, single-use withdrawal/finalization and custody refund/release transitions; preserve stored buyer identity and amounts and atomic rollback when downstream transfers fail. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:382-424; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:96-132; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.sol:186-194.

Prevent unsold inventory from being redirected, returned before ending, returned with pending liabilities or returned twice; distinguish direct donations from the authorized allocation. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:293-310; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:64.

Prevent vesting claims before the shared timestamp and preserve immutable release schedules and beneficiary ownership. Require the intended two rounds to have no pending purchases before scheduling. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:121-139; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQGlobalListing.sol:44-55.

Bind and verify the intended deployment graph, token identity, network, constructor parameters, Safe authorities and custody destination before value-bearing use. Preserve the distinction between code-enforced checks and deployment-operator obligations. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:81; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_MAINNET_ROLES.md:83-95.

Preserve locker principal and owner-only exit after expiry, prohibit shortening, and count wallet/vesting/locked principal only once when product benefits consume these positions. The latter is an offchain consumer obligation documented in ADR-008, not an invariant enforced by this locker alone. packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:69-94; docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_008_MANDATORY_LOCKING_SUBSCRIPTION_GATING.md:23-40; docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_008_MANDATORY_LOCKING_SUBSCRIPTION_GATING.md:73-79.

User-origin scope: audit presale, vesting and locking and identify/use the correct ULIQ address. The architecture review itself does not authorize deployment, activation, signatures or movement of funds.
assumptions: This was an independent, offline, read-only architecture pass, not vulnerability-audit coverage. No application code, scan tool, network call or transaction was executed; no files were modified. Citation existence/ranges were batch-checked against inspected source files.

The token address 0xF2Fa252134c84Fcf260c73665BAf3f8cCBe03EEd is supported by repository source-verification evidence for Arbitrum One and is currently present in .env.example under ULIQ_PUBLIC_PRESALE_TOKEN_ADDRESS. Its live bytecode, supply, balances and chain state were not reverified. The legacy ULIQ_TOKEN_ADDRESS remains separately blank under chain 421614 and must not be assigned the Arbitrum One address by inference. docs/archive/tasks/2026-09-05-uliq-arbiscan-source-verification.md:5-18; .env.example:118-135; .env.example:151-173.

Production V2 graph addresses, canonical USDC, sale windows, custody treasury, final Safe roles and Mainnet deployment/configuration script remain unfrozen in the inspected handoff. The current .env.example supplies the public Mainnet token but leaves other public graph addresses blank and all purchase/approval flags false. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:106-115; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_MAINNET_ROLES.md:45-55; .env.example:151-173.

The nominal Round 1 values are 50 million ULIQ, 0.002 USDC, 100,000-USDC cap, 500 minimum, 10,000 cumulative maximum, 5% initial unlock, 90-day cliff and 548-day linear vesting. Round 2 values are 100 million ULIQ, 0.0035 USDC, 350,000-USDC cap, 100 minimum, 5,000 maximum, 25% initial unlock, no cliff and 274-day linear vesting. These are contract constructor values chosen by deployment, corroborated by backend expected configuration and tests, not universal constants enforced by the generic contract. apps/api/src/uliq/publicPresale.config.ts:44-68; packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRounds.t.sol:62-110; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:159-194.

Withdrawal duration is a positive immutable constructor parameter, not hard-coded to 14 days. The audit handoff says production must freeze exactly 1,209,600 seconds subject to Legal interpretation. Main round tests use one hour; real-custody integration tests use 14 days. This is a test/deployment distinction, not proof of an incorrect production duration. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:164-193; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:51; packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRounds.t.sol:47; packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.t.sol:30.

Documentation/control discrepancy requiring a resolved product decision: ADR-001 says emergency/full-sale cancellation must remain possible, already-finalized purchases must not be treated as irreversible before Legal approval, and USDC is not automatically free treasury money. The candidate round has no cancellation state, withdraw requires PENDING_WITHDRAWAL before deadline, finalize releases USDC to treasury, and vesting only offers timestamp-based beneficiary claims. No implemented post-finalization cancellation/refund or timeout exit was found in these scoped contracts. This is an unresolved architecture/legal requirement, not an established attacker exploit. docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_001_LEGAL_PRESALE_MODEL.md:31-44; docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_001_LEGAL_PRESALE_MODEL.md:70-84; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:25-40; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:382-424; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:99-139.

Listing is owner-scheduled time metadata, not a verified DEX event or liquidity proof. If the owner never schedules listing, finalized beneficiary allocations remain unclaimable through the inspected vesting path. Deployment/runbook availability and cancellation policy therefore matter. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQGlobalListing.sol:44-55; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:121-139; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:66.

The audit handoff expects graph substitution resistance, but current onchain graph validation is partial and relies on trusted deployment/configuration review. Vesting and listing accept code-bearing contracts without complete reciprocal graph validation, and the round only checks a subset of graph relationships. Actual impact requires wrong or malicious privileged wiring; outsiders cannot rewrite immutable pointers. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:81; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:171-185; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRoundVesting.sol:75-81; packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQGlobalListing.sol:31-41.

Eligibility/KYC/allowlist requirements remain open. The inspected buy function has no identity proof, allowlist, terms signature or backend authorization input; backend feature/legal gates do not block direct calls to an activated contract. packages/contracts/src/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRound.sol:336-379; packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:112; docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_001_LEGAL_PRESALE_MODEL.md:82-84.

Legacy ULIQLocker is explicitly included by the current user's requested locking review despite being excluded from the repository's older V2 audit scope. Its constructor itself is network-neutral; chain restriction is enforced by the supplied deployment scripts and runtime configuration. No Mainnet locker selection or deployment is established. packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_V2_AUDIT_SCOPE.md:94-104; packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:47-49; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/DeployULIQLockerTestnet.s.sol:19-28; apps/api/src/uliq/config.ts:112-143.

Locker accounting records the requested amount before SafeERC20 transfer and does not measure a received balance delta; its solvency model therefore assumes the configured token transfers nominal amounts, as the scoped shared ULIQToken does. The constructor only rejects zero token address, while the locker deployment script additionally requires deployed code. Arbitrary fee-on-transfer/rebasing token deployment is a separate configuration prerequisite. packages/contracts/src/uliq/legacy-testnet/ULIQLocker.sol:47-66; packages/contracts/src/uliq/shared/ULIQToken.sol:12-23; packages/contracts/script/uliq/legacy-testnet/DeployULIQLockerTestnet.s.sol:23-28.

The main two-round tests instantiate mock custody, while ULIQPaymentCustody.t.sol separately instantiates the real custody with a real round/vesting connection. Test presence does not establish execution success or complete two-round real-custody coverage. packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPresaleRounds.t.sol:74-75; packages/contracts/test/uliq/presale-v2/ULIQPaymentCustody.t.sol:38-74.

Documentation distinguishes candidate safeguards from accepted Legal conclusions: buyer-funded withdrawal gas, safeguarding, deadline interpretation and cancellation remain blocked. No legal conclusion is inferred from source code. docs/ULIQ_Codex_Implementation_Plan/ADR_001_LEGAL_PRESALE_MODEL.md:13-17.

Parent validation after the independent source pass: the existing ULIQ token identity, supply, Treasury balance and runtime code hash were read at finalized Arbitrum One block 502625136. One local deployed-token fork lifecycle passed, using mock USDC and Safe impersonation, not broadcast or signer verification. The new real-custody regression suite passed 7 tests; one deliberately reproduces the expired READY deadlock. Final local ULIQ suite: 88 passed, 0 failed, 2 optional fork tests skipped. The date/address documentation and tests were added after review of the pinned contract revision f51e0c1309c0bdbdf36c5938e345d586bf325efb; contract source is unchanged.

surfaces.label: Buyer/custody settlement and beneficiary-bound claims
surfaces.notes: Independent baseline and focused investigator both found no ordinary-buyer asset theft, duplicate settlement or early-claim path for the configured nominal-transfer ULIQ token. Presale:336-424; custody:96-132,186-194; vesting:84-139. Parent added and ran deterministic real-custody rollback, blocked-recipient, deadline and repeated-claim tests: 7/7 passed including one operational-defect reproduction.

surfaces.label: Legacy ULIQ locker
surfaces.notes: ULIQLocker.sol:52-94 checks owner, maturity, one withdrawal, increasing extension. ULIQToken.sol:12-23 uses nominal ERC20 transfers; fee-token insolvency is not applicable to intended ULIQ. This legacy implementation has no Mainnet deployment decision.

surfaces.label: R-01: expired READY round blocks inventory return and shared vesting
surfaces.notes: Confirmed operational defect, MEDIUM severity and Mainnet blocker; not rejected as a code defect. Rejected only as an adversarial/privilege-gain finding because no unprivileged actor forcing the owner to miss activation was established. Source ULIQPresaleRound.sol:197-205,225-243,260-269,295-309; listing:32-54; vesting:121-123. Real-custody reproduction passes, asserting 100,000,000 ULIQ stranded in READY Round 2 and 250,000 finalized Round 1 ULIQ unclaimable after 500 USDC reached treasury. Correct by safely ending expired zero-purchase READY rounds; validate actual earlier-round claim and exact inventory return. Tracked as R-01 in packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_VESTING_LOCKING_REVIEW.md.

candidate.title: Expired READY round cannot end, trapping inventory and the shared listing
candidate.evidence: activateSale requires block.timestamp < saleEnd, endSale accepts only ACTIVE/PAUSED, configureSaleWindow is DRAFT-only, releaseUnsold requires ended state. Round 2 expiry after Round 1 finalization prevents both-round listing readiness.
candidate.counterevidence: Timely activation avoids defect; DRAFT permits schedule repair; ACTIVE/PAUSED can end after expiry. This is a confirmed operational lifecycle defect, not privilege escalation.
candidate.validation: Reproduced in ULIQAuditRegressionTest.testAuditReproducesExpiredReadyRoundBlockingEarlierVesting with real ULIQPaymentCustody. READY Round 2 cannot activate/end/reschedule/release; 100 million ULIQ stays in it and finalized Round 1 vesting remains zero-claimable while USDC is already at treasury.
candidate.attacker: No unprivileged attacker forcing the owner to miss activation was demonstrated.
candidate.remediation: Define and implement expired READY-to-ENDED transition for zero-purchase rounds; preserve immutable-source return and both-round listing guards; test prior finalized round claims.

surfaces.label: Caps, quotes, withdrawal capacity restoration and inventory source
surfaces.notes: PresaleRound.sol:159-220,295-333,360-400 enforces economics, exact one-time source funding, cap/wallet limits and single immutable-source unsold return. Unit/fuzz/invariant tests pass. Rounding cannot increase principal; donations remain separate. Source does not mint.

surfaces.label: One-time graph binding and privileged availability
surfaces.notes: No outsider graph substitution demonstrated. Listing.sol:32-41 and Vesting.sol:75-81 rely on trusted owner wiring, with narrower validation than Custody.sol:85-93. Round.sol:225-232 does not validate custody back-reference. Round/listing/vesting inherit Ownable.renounceOwnership; custody:168-170 forbids it. Wrong wiring, renunciation or never scheduling listing can block funds; explicit pre-value requirements remain, not new attacker capabilities.

surfaces.label: Cancellation, USDC issuer availability and direct-call access
surfaces.notes: Round.sol:382-424 permits refund only while pending and within deadline; finalization releases proceeds before listing; Vesting.sol:99-139 supplies no timeout/cancellation exit. ADR-001 cancellation/safeguarding requirements remain unresolved. Buyer refund rejection did not block treasury finalization in deterministic test.
